# `gameplay/social/SoulGraph.js`

> **Source:** `engine/gameplay/social/SoulGraph.js`

SoulGraph — The social nervous system of the world. Each NPC is a "neuron" node. Relationships are weighted edges. Events are signals. Mood is activation state. Memory is weight change. Actions are outputs. The graph propagates influence through connections. NPC = soul node Relationship = weighted edge (trust, fear, love, hate, loyalty, resentment, familiarity) Event = signal Mood = activation state Memory = weight change Action = output
